cues.en: All the seven Ivy League schools are a part of this. They have placed over $50,000,000
cues.zh: 七所常春藤盟校全都参与其中。他们今天下了价值超过5000万美元的

cues.en: worth of orders today
cues.zh: 订单

cues.en: for Macintoshes.
cues.zh: 购买Macintosh电脑。

cues.en: And they're going to be doing courseware development, leading the way really for over the other... Over 3,000 schools in this country.
cues.zh: 他们将开发课程软件，真正为全国其他……超过3000所学校带头引路。

cues.en: And they're
cues.zh: 他们

cues.en: telling us that Macintosh is the ideal college computer. So we think you're gonna see lots of Macintoshes on college campuses. And here's a list of them. Stanford, Harvard, Yale, Princeton, Dartmouth, Brown,
cues.zh: 告诉我们，Macintosh是理想的大学生电脑。所以我们认为，你会在大学校园里看到很多Macintosh。这里是名单：斯坦福、哈佛、耶鲁、普林斯顿、达特茅斯、布朗，

cues.en: on and on.
cues.zh: 等等等等。

cues.en: I think you're gonna be seeing a lot of Macintoshes on campuses.
cues.zh: 我想你们会在很多校园里看到不少 Macintosh。

cues.en: Now,
cues.zh: 现在，

cues.en: when we designed the Apple II,
cues.zh: 我们设计 Apple II 的时候，

cues.en: we designed it in a garage, but what most people don't know is we designed it to be built in a garage. And we figure if we ever made 50 of them a month, we'd be doing well.
cues.zh: 是在车库里设计的。但大多数人不知道，我们设计它时，就打算在车库里组装。我们当时觉得，就算每个月能造出 50 台，也算很不错了。

cues.en: And we surpassed that goal at this last December by over 2,000. We shipped over a 100,000 Apple IIs in December.
cues.zh: 去年 12 月，我们远远超出了这个目标，超出 2,000 多台。那个月我们交付了 10 多万台 Apple II。

cues.en: But what we wanted to do with Macintosh was make it the first personal computer that was designed from the start to be built in the millions. There's never been a personal computer that you could say this about.
cues.zh: 但我们设计 Macintosh 时，想让它成为第一款从一开始就按百万台规模制造的个人电脑。从来没有哪款个人电脑能这么说。

cues.en: We are currently making over 500 Macintoshes
cues.zh: 目前我们这座工厂每天

cues.en: a day in this factory,
cues.zh: 生产超过 500 台 Macintosh，

cues.en: and we will be ramping up to one every twenty seven seconds within the next few months.
cues.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，我们将把产能提升到每 27 秒生产一台。

cues.en: Now, Macintosh was developed by a small team of people, less than a 100. And you're gonna have a chance to to meet and ask several of them some questions tonight.
cues.zh: Macintosh 是由一个不到 100 人的小团队研发出来的。今晚大家将有机会见到其中几位，并向他们提问。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 而且，

cues.en: this group of people are... They're more like artists than they are engineers. They're not really interested in careers.
cues.zh: 这群人……他们比起工程师，其实更像是艺术家。他们并不怎么在乎世俗的职业生涯。

cues.en: What they're interested in is doing something insanely great, and then getting it out into the world to leverage their energy.
cues.zh: 他们真正关心的，是做出不可思议的伟大产品，并推向世界，让自己的心血产生最大的影响力。

cues.en: And they were able to leverage the resources of a billion dollar company in developing Macintosh.
cues.zh: 在研发 Macintosh 的过程中，他们得以调动一家十亿美元级公司的全部资源。

cues.en: And I've never in my life had the privilege of working with with such a fine, fine group of people.
cues.zh: 我一生中，从未有幸与如此优秀的一群人共事过。

cues.en: And we think, you know, Macintosh has changed our lives working with it over the last few years, and we think it's gonna change the lives of millions of people that buy them.
cues.zh: 过去几年与 Macintosh 相伴，它彻底改变了我们的生活，而我们坚信，它也将改变成千上万购买它的人的生活。

cues.en: Macintosh,
cues.zh: Macintosh，

cues.en: as you know, was was probably one of the worst kept secrets in the world.
cues.zh: 如你所知，大概是世上最难保守的秘密之一。

cues.en: But one of the best kept secrets secrets was was that that that we didn't just introduce one stand alone product again. We introduced a family of four new 32 bit products this week.
cues.zh: 但保守得最好的秘密之一是，我们不只是又推出了一款独立产品。本周我们推出了一个家族，四款全新的32位产品。

cues.en: And we introduced Lisa a year ago, and it it clearly captured the the imagination
cues.zh: 一年前我们推出了Lisa，它显然激发了想象力，

cues.en: and set the technical direction of the industry. It didn't capture as many desks as we wanted to.
cues.zh: 并确立了行业的技术方向。它占据的桌面数量却没达到我们的期望。

cues.en: But it's clear that everyone's running in the direction of mice and windows and icons. And you've seen Viseon, and you're seeing sort of the early part of MS Windows and even a rumored IBM windowing package.
cues.zh: 但很明显，大家都在朝着鼠标、窗口和图标这个方向发展。你们已经见过 Viseon，也看到了早期的 MS Windows，甚至还有传闻中的 IBM 窗口系统。

cues.en: But what we introduced in addition to Macintosh
cues.zh: 但除了 Macintosh，我们还推出了

cues.en: were three new leases.
cues.zh: 三款新产品。

cues.en: And the first one was Lisa two.
cues.zh: 第一款是 Lisa 2。

cues.en: It has a half a megabyte of RAM and a three and a half inch disk, totally compatible with Macintosh.
cues.zh: 它有半兆字节的内存和一张三点五英寸软盘，和 Macintosh 完全兼容。

cues.en: And we introduced it at $3,495,
cues.zh: 它的定价是 3495 美元，

cues.en: just a thousand dollars more than than Macintosh.
cues.zh: 只比 Macintosh 贵了 1000 美元。

cues.en: The second lease is Lisa two five. It added a five megabyte
cues.zh: 第二款 Lisa 是 Lisa 2/5，它增加了一个 5MB 的

cues.en: profile Winchester disk drive,
cues.zh: ProFile 温彻斯特硬盘，

cues.en: and that was only a thousand dollars more. Again, $44.95.
cues.zh: 售价也仅高了 1000 美元，也就是 4495 美元。

cues.en: The third lease, it was lease at $2.10.
cues.zh: 第三款是 Lisa 2/10。

cues.en: It's got a built in 10 megabyte Winchester disk drive right above the floppy there,
cues.zh: 它在软驱正上方内置了一个 10MB 的温彻斯特硬盘，

cues.en: and it's $54.95.
cues.zh: 售价是 5495 美元。

cues.en: Now all the leases, we switched over to use the three and a half inch floppy disk drive. We feel so strongly that it's the drive of the eighties.
cues.zh: 现在所有的 Lisa 都换成了 3.5 英寸软驱。我们坚信它就是属于 80 年代的驱动器。

cues.en: And it's totally compatible with Mac, and we're doing something for all the existing Lisa one owners.
cues.zh: 它完全兼容 Mac，而且我们还在为所有现有的 Lisa 1 用户做点事情。

cues.en: We are upgrading their Lisa one to a Lisa two five. That means changing the three and a half inch disk drives. They're changing the five and a quarters for three and a halves, and giving them a new front bezel and some new software.
cues.zh: 我们会把他们的 Lisa 1 升级到 Lisa 2/5。这意味着要更换 3.5 英寸软驱，把 5.25 英寸换成 3.5 英寸，再给他们新的前面板和一批新软件。

cues.en: And that upgrade's entirely free
cues.zh: 而且这次升级完全免费，

cues.en: for all existing owners.
cues.zh: 面向所有现有用户。

cues.en: So as we move forward
cues.zh: 所以随着我们向前推进，

cues.en: with the second iteration of this technology, we absolutely don't want to penalize those pioneers. And so we're just pulling them right along with us at no additional cost.
cues.zh: 进入这项技术的第二轮迭代，我们绝对不想惩罚那些先驱者。所以我们直接带着他们一起走，不收取任何额外费用。

cues.en: But the other neat thing about all the three new leases and all the Lisa ones is that they're a 100% Macintosh software compatible.
cues.zh: 但关于这三款新 Lisa 以及所有 Lisa 1 还有个很棒的特性，就是它们 100% 兼容 Macintosh 软件。

cues.en: We pulled it off.
cues.zh: 我们做到了。

cues.en: And together,
cues.zh: 它们合在一起，

cues.en: these four workstations are the foundation of what we're calling the Apple 32 SuperMicros. It's a family of compatible products based on LISA technology and 32 bit architecture.
cues.zh: 这四款工作站构成了我们所谓的 Apple 32 SuperMicro 系列的基础。这是一个基于 Lisa 技术和 32 位架构的兼容产品家族。

cues.en: And if you look at the four workstations, they now span a pretty wide range of price and performance, the way from the key building block, which is Macintosh at $24.95,
cues.zh: 如果你看这四款工作站，它们现在的价格和性能跨度相当大，从核心基石 Macintosh 的 2495 美元，

cues.en: sort of the flagship in performance, which is Lisa two ten at $54.95.
cues.zh: 一直到性能旗舰 Lisa 2/10 的 5495 美元。

cues.en: Now, let me tell you a few other things in addition to workstations, which are going to form the basis of this Supermicros family.
cues.zh: 现在，除了工作站，我再讲几件事，它们将构成这个 Supermicros 家族的基础。

cues.en: The first thing is Apple bus.
cues.zh: 第一件是 Apple 总线。

cues.en: Now, as you all know, local area networks,
cues.zh: 你们都知道，局域网这块，

cues.en: the whole area of local area networking is is a joke right now.
cues.zh: 整个局域网领域现在简直就是个笑话。

cues.en: Ethernet never really took off. IBM's been promising the world a local area network now for two years and hasn't announced anything.
cues.zh: 以太网一直没真正发展起来。IBM 两年来一直承诺要推出局域网，却至今什么都没宣布。

cues.en: And the last thing the world needs is another local area network.
cues.zh: 世界最不需要的，就是再来一种局域网。

cues.en: So what we're going to do is simply wait until those standards emerge and connect to those standards. But while those standards are emerging, people still wanna hook things together, yet they don't wanna pay a thousand dollars per computer to hook them onto some sort of network. And so what we've done is we have built in Apple bus to every single Lisa one, Lisa twos, and Macintosh.
cues.zh: 所以我们要做的就是静观其变，等这些标准成型后再去接入。但在标准成型的这段时间里，大家依然想把设备互联起来，却又不想为了连上某种网络，给每台电脑都花上一千美元。因此我们的做法是，在每一台 Lisa 1、Lisa 2 和 Macintosh 里都内置了 AppleBus。

cues.en: It's built in. It operates at 230 kilobits per second. It operates up to a thousand meters...
cues.zh: 它是内置的，运行速率为 230 kbps，传输距离最远可达一千米……

cues.en: Excuse me, thousand feet.
cues.zh: 不好意思，千英尺。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 然后

cues.en: for about $25
cues.zh: 每台电脑零售价大约 25 美元，

cues.en: per computer retail, you'll be able to buy a little box that screws on the back that simply has a little transformer and a few connectors in it, and hook up to 32
cues.zh: 你就能买到一个小盒子，拧在电脑背面，里面只有一个小型 Transformer 和几个接口，还能连接多达 32 台

cues.en: Leases, and peripherals together for virtually free.
cues.zh: 租赁设备和外围设备，几乎不花钱就能把它们连在一起。

cues.en: And we think that this will be a really good idea for the next twenty four months until the networking really shakes out. Sort of think of it as free net.
cues.zh: 我们觉得，在接下来这 24 个月里，这会是个很不错的主意，直到网络技术真正成熟。可以把它想成免费网络。

cues.en: The next thing that we need to do is we need to print out these amazing graphics that we can create. And we have an... The ImageWriter printer, which we think is a pretty much of a breakthrough in terms of the price to do this. It sells for $6,595,
cues.zh: 接下来我们要做的，是把我们创造出的这些精美图形打印出来。我们有一款 ImageWriter 打印机，我们认为它在价格方面算得上一个突破。售价 6595 美元，

cues.en: and when you buy it with a Macintosh, it's $495.
cues.zh: 搭配 Macintosh 购买的话，是 495 美元。

cues.en: But something we're really excited about is higher resolution
cues.zh: 但真正让我们兴奋的是更高分辨率的

cues.en: dot printing.
cues.zh: 点阵打印。

cues.en: And before the end of 1984,
cues.zh: 在 1984 年底之前，

cues.en: we will introduce a breakthrough
cues.zh: 我们将推出一项突破性的

cues.en: in laser xerographic printing for under $5,000.
cues.zh: 激光静电复印打印技术，价格低于 5000 美元。

cues.en: And we're working very hard on that, and I think when you see the results,
cues.zh: 而且我们正在全力推进这件事。我想等你看到成果时，

cues.en: you'll be really happy.
cues.zh: 一定会很满意。

cues.en: Next thing that we need is we need to talk to these big blue mainframes.
cues.zh: 接下来，我们得想办法和这些大型蓝色主机对话。

cues.en: And to do that, we've got a little box called the Appaline box for about a thousand dollars. It's available now, and it hooks up to any Macintosh or Lisa, talks full thirty two seventy eight datacom with any IBM mainframe does it as well or better than an IBM PC.
cues.zh: 为此，我们有个叫 Appaline box 的小盒子，售价大约一千美元。它现在已经可以买到，可以连接任何一台 Macintosh 或 Lisa，通过全套 3278 数据通信协议与任何 IBM 主机通信，效果和 IBM PC 一样好，甚至更好。

cues.en: This fall,
cues.zh: 今年秋天，

cues.en: you'll see small file servers in the 10 to 20 megabyte class that hook up to Apple bus and a shared Winchester that you can share among a bunch of Macintoshes and Leases.
cues.zh: 你们会看到 10 到 20 兆字节级别的小型文件服务器，它们连接到 Apple bus，还带有共享温彻斯特硬盘，供一堆 Macintosh 和 Lisa 共享使用。

cues.en: It'd be very, very inexpensive.
cues.zh: 它会非常非常便宜。

cues.en: And then something that we'll hope to get out late this year or early next year is a Unix server.
cues.zh: 另外，我们希望在今年底或明年初推出一款 Unix 服务器。

cues.en: And we think Unix is a pretty lousy operating system to put inside a workstation. It's old technology, and it's really big, and you need a Winchester. So you can never make the workstations cheap. But we think it's a great operating system when you're in a multi user environment.
cues.zh: 我们认为把 Unix 装进工作站里挺糟糕的。那是老技术了，体积庞大，而且你必须配温彻斯特硬盘。这样工作站就永远做不便宜。但我们觉得，在多用户环境下，它绝对是个很棒的操作系统。

cues.en: And what we're going to be doing is coming out with a server,
cues.zh: 我们接下来要推出的一款服务器，

cues.en: which is a large disk, a very fast CPU that hangs on the network that allows you to run Unix and vertical applications on top of it and use the Macintoshes and Leases as really sort of new wave terminals
cues.zh: 它是一块大容量磁盘、一颗高速 CPU，挂在网络上，让你能在上面运行 Unix 和垂直应用，并把 Macintosh 和 Leases 当作新式的终端

cues.en: into that software. Now,
cues.zh: 接入那套软件。现在，

cues.en: we thought long and hard about whether we should come out with an IBM PC compatible.
cues.zh: 我们反复权衡过是否要推出一款 IBM PC 兼容机。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 而且

cues.en: we do a lot of market research. We have a pretty good brand out there in the marketplace, and we could have sold a lot of them.
cues.zh: 我们做了大量市场调研。我们在市场上品牌不错，本可以卖出很多台。

cues.en: But that's not what we wanted to do. What we wanna do is we want to establish a second standard in the office
cues.zh: 但那不是我们想做的事。我们想做的是在办公室建立第二个标准

cues.en: based on radical ease of use and the kind of power that these
cues.zh: 基于极致的易用性以及这些

cues.en: workstations are able to provide.
cues.zh: 工作站所能提供的那种强大能力。

cues.en: But we know that if we're gonna do that, we need to build bridges to the IBM world.
cues.zh: 但我们知道，如果要做到这一点，就得搭建通往 IBM 世界的桥梁。

cues.en: We think there's three major bridges that we have to build. The first one, and most importantly,
cues.zh: 我们认为必须搭建三座主要的桥梁。第一座，也是最重要的，

cues.en: is for all the great software that runs in the IBM products, we've gotta have better versions running on our Apple 32 workstations.
cues.zh: 就是对于那些在 IBM 产品上运行的优秀软件，我们要让更好的版本运行在 Apple 32 工作站上。

cues.en: And I think by this summer or early fall, we will have accomplished that goal.
cues.zh: 我想，到今年夏天或初秋，我们就能实现这个目标。

cues.en: The second is local area network support. We expect IBM to introduce one or two local area networks in the April, May, June time frame, and we will connect
cues.zh: 第二项是支持局域网。我们预计 IBM 会在四、五月或六月推出一两种局域网，我们会接入

cues.en: to the most prevalent of those networks.
cues.zh: 其中应用最广泛的网络。

cues.en: And the third is the three thousand two and seventy eight data communications,
cues.zh: 第三项是 3278 数据通信，

cues.en: which we're doing now. So we think if we build these three bridges to the IBM network, that we can continue
cues.zh: 这是我们正在做的。因此，我们认为，只要搭好这三座通往 IBM 网络的桥梁，就能继续

cues.en: to sell better computers.
cues.zh: 销售更好的计算机。

cues.en: Now,
cues.zh: 现在，

cues.en: if you go back about a hundred years to the eighteen eighty's,
cues.zh: 如果回到大约一百年前的19世纪80年代，

cues.en: there were approximately 20, 25,000 trained telegraph operators in The United States. And you really could send a telegram between Boston and San Francisco, and it'd take about three or four hours and go through the relay stations, and it really worked. And it was a great breakthrough in technology that had been around for about thirty, forty years.
cues.zh: 全美大概有两万到两万五千名受过训练的电报员。你确实可以从波士顿给旧金山发一封电报，途经几个中继站，大概需要三四个小时，而且它确实很管用。这在当时是一项已经存在了三四十年之久的重大技术突破。

cues.en: And there were some people that talked about putting a telegraph machine on every desk in America to improve productivity.
cues.zh: 当时甚至有人提议，给全美每张办公桌都配一台电报机来提高生产力。

cues.en: Now what those people didn't know
cues.zh: 但这些人当时并不知道，

cues.en: was about the same time
cues.zh: 就在差不多同一时期，

cues.en: Alexander Graham Bell filed the original patents for the telephone.
cues.zh: Alexander Graham Bell 提交了电话的原始专利申请。

cues.en: A breakthrough in technology.
cues.zh: 这是技术上的一次重大突破。

cues.en: Because putting a telegraph machine on every desk in America to improve productivity wouldn't have worked.
cues.zh: 因为靠在全美每张办公桌上放一台电报机来提高效率，根本行不通。

cues.en: People wouldn't have spent the twenty to forty to a hundred hours to learn Morse code.
cues.zh: 人们不可能花上二三十甚至上百个小时，去专门学习摩尔斯电码。

cues.en: They just wouldn't have done it.
cues.zh: 他们根本不会去做。

cues.en: But with the telephone, within ten years, there were over 200,000
cues.zh: 但有了电话之后，不到十年，美国办公桌上就出现了超过 20 万部

cues.en: telephones on desks in America. It was a breakthrough because people already knew how to use it. It performed the same basic function, but radical ease of use. And in addition to just letting you type in the words or click in the words, it let you sing. It let you intone your sentences to really get your meanings across.
cues.zh: 电话。这是一次突破，因为人们已经知道怎么用它了。它执行的是同样的基本功能，但使用起来极其简便。而且，除了让你打字输入或点击输入文字之外，它还让你能唱。它让你给句子配上语调，真正把意思传达出去。

cues.en: We are at that juncture in our industry right now. There are people suggesting
cues.zh: 我们这个行业现在正处在这样的关口。有人建议

cues.en: that we should put a current generation box
cues.zh: 给每个人的办公桌上都放一台当代的机器

cues.en: on everyone's desk to improve productivity.
cues.zh: 来提高生产力。

cues.en: A telegraph,
cues.zh: 一台电报机，

cues.en: if you will.
